description: Customer claims they did not receive the product.

required_evidence.description: Original order record with shipping address
Delivery confirmation with signature or photo
Customer communication acknowledging delivery or address
Delivery policy terms accepted by customer

known_failure_modes: Delivery confirmation is for a different address than the order
Tracking shows 'delivered' but no signature proof
Delivery date is before the dispatch date (data error)
Customer provided alternative address verbally but no written record
